name: bannerstop/sonar-php
description: PHP client for sonar: Pulses from jobs, the runtime report, error and exception handlers and a Monolog handler; short timeouts, an on-disk buffer for outages and no required dependencies

suggest.ext-curl: The default transport; without it the stream transport is used
suggest.psr/http-client: To send Pulses through a PSR-18 client with Psr18Transport
suggest.psr/http-factory: PSR-17 request and stream factories for Psr18Transport
suggest.monolog/monolog: To report log records through SonarHandler (Monolog 2 and 3; 1.x has the same array records but is not tested)
